claims.evidence: Witness report shows wooden pallets with some stamps/labels and printed markings, but no clear HT/IPPC stamp details or readable proof of 'foreign' origin.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted
claims.evidence: Witness close-up shows heavy dirt/marks, discoloration, and worn/dirty appearance; debris is visible in the yard.
Photos do not show moisture content testing or any method to confirm whether water was added.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale photo/receipt or weight ticket is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Moisture/condition risk (wet/treated/dirty pallets reduce usability and resale value; may cause odor, mold, or rejection by buyers).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of a moisture meter reading on multiple pallets plus close-ups of any mold/odor indicators (and/or a simple moisture test result sheet).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/worn pallets with possible dirt/condition issues (worst-case: not suitable for immediate clean reuse).

risks.risk: Safety/structural integrity risk (broken boards, missing nails, cracks, unsafe pallets).
risks.proof: A video walk-around showing underside and top surfaces with counts of broken/missing boards and a few pallets being lifted to show flex/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed-condition pallets with some unusable units.

risks.risk: Export compliance risk (HT/IPPC status and stamp details determine whether pallets can be used for international shipping).
risks.proof: Close-up, readable photos of the full IPPC/HT stamp on multiple pallets (including the code and treatment mark).
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-certified/unknown treatment pallets (worst-case: only suitable for local use/scrap).

risks.risk: Quantity/weight accuracy risk (lot may not equal the stated weight; buyer may receive less).
risks.proof: Photo of the certified scale display during weighing + a receipt/weight ticket showing total kg and time.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming the lot may be less than claimed and/or mixed density (worst-case: lower usable quantity).

risks.risk: Sorting/readiness risk (whether pallets are banded/strapped and easy to load; loose stacks increase handling cost).
risks.proof: Photos showing how the pallets are bundled/strapped (or not), plus a loading/stacking readiness shot from the side.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming loose, unbundled pallets requiring extra labor to load.

proof_requests: Send clear, readable close-ups of IPPC/HT stamps (front and back) from multiple pallets, including the treatment code.
Provide a short video showing underside and top surfaces of several pallets, highlighting any broken boards/cracks/missing nails.
Share photos of a moisture test (moisture meter readings) or any condition test results, plus close-ups for mold/odor indicators.
Upload the certified scale weight ticket/receipt and a photo of the scale display during weighing.
Confirm the exact lot quantity/weight breakdown (how many pallets) and show whether pallets are banded/strapped for loading.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as wooden pallets, so pricing can proceed at a worst-case used/dirty/mixed-condition level. Several seller claims (clean/dry, weight, foreign/export compliance) are not proven by the report, so the price should reflect those uncertainties.
